column31: scaffold_info.tsv SNV_count/SNS_count/divergent_site_count (calc_snps in inStrain/profile/snv_utilities.py:249-272) count the last cumulative_snv_table record per position at mm<=max_mm WITHOUT filtering cryptic==True sites (where divergent_site_count = SNV_count + SNS_count + zero_allele_divergent_site_count); exported <prefix>_SNVs.tsv (SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table in inStrain/SNVprofile.py:495-510) filters cryptic==False BEFORE sorting mm and keeping last per (scaffold, position). Both counts are reproducible with distinct meanings: summary divergent_site_count = exported non-cryptic rows + excluded cryptic positions; zero exported variants does not imply zero summary sites when cryptic sites are present.
